question: What stirring reveals the clear form of the power of action?
premises: The power of action has a manifest form.
A stirring arises in the unfolding of will.
This stirring operates in mutual relation.
inference: The mutual stirring born of the unfolding of will clearly manifests the form of the power of action.
uncertainties: The exact antecedent of tadgaterapi is slightly compressed.
plain_english: The stirring that arises in the unfolding of will, mutually interacting, clearly manifests the form of the power of action; this is also said of that movement.
